evomod2: individual-based simulations of genetic architecture evolution

Source: R/evomod2-package.R
evomod2-package.Rd

Build a model from an architecture (additive(), multilinear(), binary_b()) and a mutation model (mutation(), binary_b_mutation()) with evomod_model(), then run it through selection regimes (drift(), stabilizing(), directional()) with evolve(). Recorded statistics: trait_means(), variances(), g_matrices(), g_decomposition(). Loci are unlinked unless a genetic_map() is given to evomod_model().

Details

New components (architectures, mutation models, fitness functions) are C++ classes in src/evomod.h; see the "Extending evomod2" section of the README.
